The Hyderabad police have cautioned women to be wary of an online scam that offers a ‘fake boyfriend’ on ‘rent’, charging money for coffee dates, movie dates, accompanying for shopping, events, etc. Hyderabad Commissioner of Police VC Sajjanar said that this was a new ‘dating trap’ set by cyber fraudsters. The Commissioner said that posters were being circulated on Instagram, Telegram, and Facebook, featuring discount packages with captions such as "1st August Special - 50% OFF" and "Rent-a-Boyfriend – Your Personal Companion."
